title: Show sync state on both devices
problem: Each device knows only its own switches. A page says "sync is on" while the other device drops the data.
fix: shared: one small "sharing state" message per paired device (each category on or off, vault open). Every page that syncs shows it in its header, on desktop and phone, with the step to fix it there.

items.screen: Desktop Vault, Notes, Clipboard, Scribe headers; mobile Sync sharing
items.title: Neither device knows the other's sync switches
items.what: Each device knows only its own switches. A receiver that has a category off, or a locked vault, drops the data and tells the sender nothing. The desktop header says '<Label> sync is on' from its own send switch alone. The phone drops copied text when its switch is off.
items.risk: Desktop shows a green 'sync is on' while nothing reaches the phone. The user cannot tell which device holds it back.
items.rec: shared: add one small 'sharing state' message per peer (each category on/off, receive on/off, vault open). pro + mobile: the page header reads it and says 'Off on <device>. Turn on <category> there.'

items.title: Vault never says to open the other vault
items.what: Vault items move only while both vaults are unlocked. The phone vault locks every time the app goes to the background. Desktop says this only in a tooltip. The phone says it only in the empty state. With items present, neither side says the other vault is locked.
items.risk: A password saved on the computer never reaches a phone that looks set up. The user assumes vault sync is broken.
items.rec: shared: carry 'vault open' in the peer state message. pro + mobile: one line on the Vault page, 'Open your vault on <device> to sync', shown only while the other vault is locked.

items.screen: Desktop Transfer activity and device card; mobile Sync activity
items.title: Waiting transfer never says to open the phone app
items.what: The phone syncs only while the app is open, and says so on its own Sync screen. Desktop says 'Waiting for this device to reconnect.' and never names the step. The phone's waiting row says only 'Pending'. For an offline device both apps offer only 'Pair again'.
items.risk: The user waits for a file that will not move. Or they pair a healthy device again.
items.rec: shared: add a pending reason with the peer platform to the activity item and the offline device row, 'Open Off Grid AI on <device>, on the same Wi-Fi.' Both apps render it.

items.title: Arrivals raise no system notification
items.what: A received file shows only in the in-app list and bell badge on both apps. Neither posts a system notification from sync. The phone asks for notification permission only in the film feature.
items.risk: A file sent to the other device goes unseen until the user opens the app and looks.
items.rec: pro + mobile: post a local system notification on receive, 'File from <device>', that opens the file. mobile: ask for notification permission when the user turns on Sync or Receiving.

items.title: Phone pages lack the sync control desktop has
items.what: Desktop has the sync header control on Vault, Notes, Clipboard and Scribe. The phone shows vault sync state only when the vault is empty. Phone Notes and Improve say nothing about sync.
items.risk: The founder's Vault example repeats on the phone. A page looks complete while its sync is off.
items.rec: mobile: one header icon that mirrors SyncCategoryAction (pair, on, off) on Vault, Notes and Improve, opening Sync sharing.

items.screen: Desktop pairing dialog; mobile pairing code sheet
items.title: Old app version ends as 'Pairing timed out'
items.what: A pairing message with another version number is dropped. No reply goes back. Desktop has no 'update' copy in Sync. The phone QR scanner does say 'This code needs a newer version of Off Grid AI Mobile.' The phone's per-device code sheet turns the same case into 'That is not a pairing code.'
items.risk: After one app updates, pairing fails with a timeout. Nobody says to update the other app.
items.rec: shared: reject an unknown pairing version with a typed code and the line 'Update Off Grid AI on <device>.' mobile: pass the unsupported-version reason through the code sheet.

items.title: Phone-sent model shows as loose files on desktop
items.what: The phone starts one receive job per model and shows one named row. The desktop receive path starts no job. Desktop Activity lists raw file rows, so a vision model is two .gguf rows.
items.risk: The desktop user cannot tell that a model is arriving or when it is ready.
items.rec: pro: start and complete a receive job in the desktop sink and build model rows from jobs, as the phone does. The shared job model already exists.

items.title: Phone says notes stay on device; they sync
items.what: The phone's empty Notes page says 'They stay on this device.' Notes sync is on by default on both apps. Desktop Notes shows the sync control in its header.
items.risk: A user who expects notes to stay on the phone finds them on the computer. That breaks trust in a privacy product.
items.rec: mobile: change the line to say notes sync to paired devices, and add the sync header icon.

items.title: Note sync problems reach logs only
items.what: A note that fails to send, follow or merge is written to the log on both apps. Notes are hidden from the Activity list. A conflict keeps both copies and tells nobody.
items.risk: A note that did not arrive looks the same as one never written. A conflict copy appears with no reason.
items.rec: shared: expose a per-note state (arriving, failed, conflict copy kept). pro + mobile: show it on the note row with Retry.

items.screen: Desktop Devices (pairing code and empty list)
items.title: Desktop pairing never points to the phone app
items.what: Desktop says 'Scan from another Off Grid AI device, or enter the code.' A link to the mobile app exists only in the sidebar. The phone's empty state says 'Open Sync on a nearby device' and does not name the desktop app or its screen.
items.risk: A new user at the QR code has no phone app and no link to it. A phone user looks for 'Sync' on a desktop that calls it 'Devices'.
items.rec: pro: add 'No phone app yet? Get it' beside the QR, using the existing link, and 'On the phone: Sync, then scan.' mobile: name the desktop screen in the empty state.

items.title: One screen, four names: Devices, Sync, Personal Mesh
items.what: Desktop calls the screen 'Devices' and 'Devices and sync'. The phone calls it 'Sync'. Desktop setup says 'Pair Off Grid AI Mobile through Personal Mesh.' The phone says 'open Sync' in one sheet and 'open the Devices screen' in another. The phone guide button for its own Sync screen reads 'Open Devices'.
items.risk: Each app sends the user to a screen name that does not exist on the other.
items.rec: shared: one constant for the screen name (recommend 'Sync'). desktop, pro, mobile: use it in titles and in every pointer to the other app.

items.screen: Sync, Tools, Clipboard, Scribe, Activity (both apps)
items.title: Same features carry different names per app
items.what: Desktop 'Remote actions' is the phone's 'Desktop tools'; the error sent to the phone says 'Remote task access'. Desktop 'Evict' is the phone's 'Forget'. Desktop 'Scribe' is the phone's 'Improve'; the sync category is 'Writing'. Category 'Copied text' is the phone's 'Clipboard sync'. Desktop 'Transfer activity' and 'Files' are the phone's 'Sync activity' and 'Synced files'. Desktop prints raw status words; the phone prints 'Sent', 'Could not send'. The phone says 'the Mac' for any computer.
items.risk: Help text and error lines from one app use words the other app does not show. The user cannot find the control.
items.rec: shared: one label table for these features, the remove verb and the status words. pro + mobile: read labels from it.

items.title: Phone copy limits never reach the desktop
items.what: On iPhone the paste-permission guide opens only when Clipboard sync is turned on from Sync sharing, not from the Clipboard page. On Android the phone captures a copy only through 'Copy to Off Grid AI'. Desktop Clipboard shows 'Copied text sync is on' and says nothing of either limit.
items.risk: The user copies on the phone and it never appears on the computer. Desktop shows sync as on.
items.rec: mobile: trigger the paste guide from one shared hook used by both switches. pro: when the paired device is Android, add the hint 'On Android, choose Copy to Off Grid AI' to the Clipboard header tooltip.

items.screen: Vault, Notes, Clipboard, Scribe headers; Devices (devices); Settings > Device sync
items.title: Sync not running: control vanishes, no retry
items.what: When sync status cannot be read, the new header control (SyncCategoryAction) renders nothing. The Devices screen shows a red banner with Dismiss only. Settings shows 'Sync is not running: …' with only 'Manage devices'. The switches in Sync sharing also have no error handling: a failed write leaves the switch as it was with no message.
items.risk: On Vault or Notes the sync control just disappears. On the Sync screen there is a reason but no way to restart.
items.rec: Give SyncCategoryAction an error state ('Sync is not running') that opens the Sync screen. Add Retry (the existing refresh) to both banners. Route switch failures into the screen's existing error banner.

items.screen: Sidebar, Devices (devices) title, Settings, Pro page
items.title: Sync has three names and stale Pro copy
items.what: The sidebar and Pro page say 'Devices and sync'. The screen title is 'Devices'. The Settings card is 'Device sync'. The tab is 'Sync sharing'. The Pro page says sync covers 'chats, projects and model settings' and leaves out notes, vault, clipboard and writing. Vault copy says sync is 'via EasyShare', a name used nowhere else.
items.risk: The user looks for 'Sync' and meets three labels. The Pro page undersells what syncs.
items.rec: Use one name on the sidebar, the screen title and the Settings card. List every synced category in the Pro copy. Drop 'EasyShare'.

items.screen: Vault, Notes, Clipboard, Scribe headers; Devices (devices) > Sync sharing; Models (models)
items.title: Sync on, but no sign anything synced
items.what: The header control says only 'X sync is on'. Every category hides its activity, so there is no 'last synced' or 'failed' per category. The Sync screen shows per-device 'Last connected' and one global count. 'Model settings' is the one switchable category whose own screen (Models) has no sync control at all.
items.risk: The user turns on Notes or Vault sync and cannot tell whether anything moved or failed.
items.rec: Add last-synced time and pending count per category to the sync status. Show it in the SyncCategoryAction tooltip and in the Sync sharing row. Let SyncCategoryAction take 'model-settings' and mount it on Models.

items.screen: Phone guide topics Vault, Notes, 'Your chats, on every device'
items.title: Guide promises sync that is off by default
items.what: phone-vault says 'Paired, it stays the same on your computer'. phone-sync says copied text stays current. The checked flows say vault sharing is 'Off by default' and copied text moves only 'after you turn this on'. The guide topic and its 'Open Vault' / 'Open Clipboard' button never say so.
items.risk: A user pairs, expects passwords and clipboard on the other device, sees nothing, and gets no reason or switch.
items.rec: shared: change the copy to 'when you turn on Vault sharing'. mobile: give the Vault and Clipboard headers the sync state control the desktop got (8c6399065).

items.screen: Phone guide topic 'Your chats, on every device' -> 'Open Devices'
items.title: Button says Devices; phone screen is Sync
items.what: The button reads 'Open Devices'. The phone's row and every phone flow say Settings > Sync ('Sync with Pro' without Pro). The desktop screen is 'Devices and sync'.
items.risk: Three names for one feature. The guide's own steps ('Settings > Sync') do not match its button.
items.rec: mobile: change the label to 'Open Sync'.

items.title: Vault never says sync is off or unpaired
items.what: Vault reads the vault sharing switch once and uses it only in the empty state. Vault sharing is off by default. With one item in the vault, the header shows only New and Lock. The screen never reads paired or connected computers. The empty state with sharing off opens Sync sharing, never pairing; with sharing on it has no sync button at all. Vault also syncs only while it is unlocked on the phone, and no screen says so.
items.risk: You add one login on the phone and wait for your computer's passwords. They never come. Nothing says the switch is off, that no computer is paired, or that Vault must be open here.
items.rec: Port the desktop header control (SyncCategoryAction) into the Vault ScreenHeader: off = one tap turns it on (the call already exists in Sync sharing), on = opens Sync sharing, no paired device = opens Sync to pair. Use the same control in the empty state. Add one line: 'Syncs while Vault is open here and on your computer.'

items.title: Notes shows no sync state; its copy is wrong
items.what: Notes and Note read nothing from sync. The empty state says notes 'stay on this device', while notes sharing is on by default. Delete dialogs always say 'here and on your paired devices', even with sharing off or no computer paired.
items.risk: You cannot tell whether a note reaches your computer, and you cannot turn sharing on or pair from Notes. The text says the opposite of what happens.
items.rec: Same header control as Vault, bound to the notes category. Make the 'paired devices' clause conditional, as the Vault item screen already does ('when Vault sync is on').

items.title: Sync that fails to start shows 'Loading...' forever
items.what: A failed start stores its reason, and the shared view model exposes it as local.error. No screen reads it. The pairing code shows 'Loading...', and Show QR, Scan and Rescan are disabled.
items.risk: Three grey icons and 'Loading...' with no reason and no retry. Pairing is impossible and you do not know why.
items.rec: Show local.error with a Retry that starts sync again, in the card the Sync screen already uses for licence reconciliation.

items.title: After activating Pro: 'Got it' and nothing else
items.what: Success shows 'Pro is active on this device' and 'Got it'. The licensed Pro page lists three features (Sync, Clipboard, tools); the Pro tab lists eight. Onboarding promised 'Pro features start once you have Pro. Your picks are kept', but nothing sets up the models for those picks after activation.
items.risk: You just paid and see a tick and three rows. Notes, Vault, Video and Voice are not named. The Pro features you picked still have no models.
items.rec: Build the 'Included with Pro' list from the same source as the Pro tab. When Pro picks exist, add 'Set up my Pro picks' to the success card, opening the existing auto setup.

items.screen: Pro tab, Guide, Settings, Pro page
items.title: Sync and Pro tools go by three names each
items.what: The screen and the Settings row are called 'Sync'. The guide button says 'Open Devices', and the Pro tab row is 'Your chats, on every device'. The Pro tab row 'MCP tools' has the button 'Open Tools' and opens a screen titled 'Pro tools'; a separate free screen is titled 'Tools'. The licence row promises 'Devices, renewal and restore': renewal is plain text and restore does not exist.
items.risk: Someone looking for 'Sync' in the Pro tab finds no row with that word. 'Open Devices' opens a screen called Sync. 'Restore' is promised and absent.
items.rec: Use one name per screen: 'Open Sync', 'Open Pro tools', and a mobile label 'Sync' for the Pro tab row (the label override exists). Change the licence row to 'Devices and renewal', and make 'Manage subscription' open the support email.
